critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_quiz_results generates a NEW uuid on every request instead of returning the stored record's id (see line ~297: `{'id': str(uuid.uuid4()), **d}`). Frontend keys rows by this id which changes every fetch — harmless for React (full re-render on refetch) but wasteful and misleading (the persisted id in Mongo is ignored). Recommend: rely on the stored `id` field (already inserted at quiz_submit line ~287) and drop the uuid override, OR project it explicitly. Low priority — no functional bug.
